arxiv-2210-13284.title: Study of I = 0 I=0 bottomonium bound states and resonances based on lattice QCD static potentials
arxiv-2210-13284.creator: Marc Wagner
arxiv-2210-13284.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Marc Wagner. We investigate I = 0 I=0 bottomonium bound states and resonances in S, P, D and F waves using lattice QCD static-static-light-light potentials. We consider five coupled channels, one confined quarkonium and four open B ( ∗ ) ​ B ¯ ( ∗ ) B^{(*)}\bar{B}^{(*)} and B s ( ∗ ) ​ B ¯ s ( ∗ ) B^{(*)}_{s}\bar{B}^{(*)}_{s} meson-meson channels and use the Born-Oppenheimer approximation and the emergent wave method to compute poles of the T matrix.

arxiv-2406-12631.title: Nonreciprocal Bundle Emissions of Quantum Entangled Pairs
arxiv-2406-12631.creator: Qian Bin, Hui Jing, Ying Wu, Franco Nori, Xin-You Lü
arxiv-2406-12631.description: Abstract Realizing precise control over multiquanta emission is crucial for quantum information processing, especially when integrated with advanced techniques of manipulating quantum states. Here, by spinning the resonator to induce the Sagnac effect, we can obtain nonreciprocal photon-phonon and photon-magnon super-Rabi oscillations under conditions of optically driving resonance transitions.

arxiv-2501-07176.title: Constraints on extended axion structures from the lensing of fast radio bursts
arxiv-2501-07176.creator: Jan Tristram Acuña, Kuan-Yen Chou, and Po-Yan Tseng
arxiv-2501-07176.description: Abstract Axions are hypothetical pseudoscalar particles that have been regarded as promising dark matter (DM) candidates. On the other hand, extended compact objects such as axion stars, which are supported by gravity and axion self interactions, may have also been formed in the early Universe and comprise part of DM.

arxiv-2601-03643.title: On k -connectivity oracles in k -connected graphs
arxiv-2601-03643.creator: Zeev Nutov
arxiv-2601-03643.description: Abstract A k k -connectivity oracle for a graph G = ( V , E ) G=(V,E) is a data structure that given s , t ∈ V s,t\in V determines whether there are at least k + 1 k+1 internally disjoint s ​ t st -paths in G G .

arxiv-2602-05750.title: The 2-Dimensional Dual of ϕ 𝟒 \phi^{4} in AdS 3
arxiv-2602-05750.creator: Weichen Xiao, Ivo Sachs
arxiv-2602-05750.description: Abstract We study the correlation functions of a conformally coupled ϕ 4 \phi^{4} -interacting theory in AdS 3 and its dual CFT 2 . The one-loop diagram is not expressible in terms of known transcendental functions, but is shown to be expressible as an infinite sum of previously well-studied tree-level diagrams, and we compute this sum using several number-theoretic conjectures.

pmc-11525620.title: Investigation of in situ and ex situ mode of lactic acid bacteria incorporation and the effect on dough extensibility, bread texture and flavor quality during shelf-life
pmc-11525620.creator: Yining Dong, Elham Chidar, Salwa Karboune
pmc-11525620.description: Lactococcus lactis subsp. diacetylactis, Lactobacillus delbrueckii subsp. bulgaricus, and Lb. rhamnosus were evaluated for their efficiencies in preserving bread texture and flavor during shelf-life. The investigated LABs exhibited efficiency during preliminary screening in expressing selected enzymes (protease, xylanase, α-amylase, laccase, and glucose oxidase) and producing exopolysaccharide (EPS).

pmc-12369038.title: Effects of direction and gender on lower limb biomechanics during forward lunges in badminton players: a preliminary analysis
pmc-12369038.creator: Li Huang, Yan Zhang, Shunxiang Gao, Junxia Lin, Fei Zheng, Yaodong Gu
pmc-12369038.description: BackgroundThe lunge is a critical movement in badminton, facilitating rapid and efficient court coverage and enabling players to promptly reach the hitting position. While previous studies have examined the influence of lunge direction on lower limb biomechanics, the effects of gender have yet to be explored.

pmc-12398346.title: Dietary Intake and Quality in Irritable Bowel Syndrome: A Comparative Study With Controls and the Association With Symptom Severity
pmc-12398346.creator: Sanna Nybacka, Esther Colomier, Jóhann Páll Hreinsson, Stine Störsrud, Jan Tack, Hans Törnblom, Magnus Simrén
pmc-12398346.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). INTRODUCTION:Patients with irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) often attribute the onset or worsening of gastrointestinal symptoms to intake of food. Hence, to alleviate symptoms, patients with IBS may avoid triggering foods, potentially impacting their dietary intake and diet quality.

pmc-12454062.title: Experiences, perceptions and unexpressed needs of patients undergoing heart and lung transplantation in intensive care unit: a qualitative phenomenological study
pmc-12454062.creator: Nikita Valentina Ugenti, Silvio Quirini, Marianna Aleandri, Vittorio Di Filippo, Stefano Durante, Alice Ferretti, Carolina Guerrieri, Carmela Martella, Angela Peghetti, Silvia Sgarzi, Sara Valentini, Angela Vetromile, Elena Lia
pmc-12454062.description: IntroductionPatients in intensive care units require advanced clinical care as well as attention to psychological social and emotional needs, often overlooked. Heart and lung transplant recipients experience a particularly complex postoperative journey, marked by physical fragility, emotional vulnerability, and identity transformation.

pmc-12556962.title: RAPIDE Project: protecting regular care and advancing pandemic preparedness
pmc-12556962.creator: A Timen
pmc-12556962.description: During the COVID-19 pandemic, a great amount of regular healthcare across Europe was adjusted, postponed, or even stopped. The disruptions involved the entire spectrum of care, with delays in treatment for elective surgeries, chronic conditions, cancer care, and mental health.

pmc-12683132.title: Three-dimensional dynamic simulation–assisted thoracoscopic complex right S7+S10 segmentectomy
pmc-12683132.creator: Dorian Rojas, Karel Pfeuty
pmc-12683132.description: Graphical Abstract 3D dynamics simulation-assisted thoracoscopic complex right S7 + S10 segmentectomy. Central Message Three-dimensional dynamic simulation is an innovative and reliable tool, allowing safe and accurate lung-sparing surgery in the growing era of complex basal segmentectomy. Minimally invasive segmentectomy has emerged as a lung-sparing alternative to lobectomy for selected patients with early-stage lung cancer or metastatic disease.

pmc-12713123.title: Redefining CMR reference standards through prognostic validation
pmc-12713123.creator: Zahra Raisi-Estabragh, Matthias G Friedrich
pmc-12713123.description: phenotype is also importantly influenced by environmental and genetic exposures – which may exert healthy or unhealthy remodeling patterns, without necessarily causing overt cardiovascular disease. Such phenotypic features are quantified by metrics derived from CMR, with variations in reference ranges depending on the composition of the underlying cohort.

pmc-12805459.title: Unravelling the differential responses of critically endangered Onobrychis conferta populations to drought and salinity stress
pmc-12805459.creator: A. Sakhraoui, H.B. Ltaeif, J.M. Castillo, S. Rouz
pmc-12805459.description: Understanding stress responses of endangered plants is vital for their conservation under climate change. We examined the effects of iso-osmotic drought (PEG) and salinity (NaCl) on the growth and physiology of three populations of the critically endangered legume Onobrychis conferta subsp. conferta (OC1, OC2, OC3) endemic to North-Western Tunisia.

pmc-12926248.title: A green approach to Azo dye C.I. Disperse blue 291 treatment: mitigating ecotoxicological effects through enzymatic and adsorptive strategies using endophytic fungi
pmc-12926248.creator: Esperança Edna Alexandre Chibite, Débora Elisa Antunes de Mendonça, Mariane Aparecida Franco de Godoy, Adriane do Nascimento, João Artur dos Santos Oliveira, Brian Alvarez Ribeiro de Melo, Michele Cristina Heck, Julio Cesar Polonio, Igor Vivian Almeida, Veronica Elisa Pimenta Vicentini
pmc-12926248.description: Textile dyes are persistent pollutants that pose significant risks to the environment and living organisms. Before being released into aquatic ecosystems, these dyes require effective treatment. Among these dyes, the azo dye Disperse Blue 291 exhibits relevant toxicological and mutagenic activity.

pmc-12997002.title: Dataset of groundwater bacterial communities at varying distances from public cemeteries in surakarta, Indonesia
pmc-12997002.creator: Triastuti Rahayu, Yasir Sidiq, Nur Miladan, Arief Budiono, Noor Alis Setiyadi, Bambang Budhi Santosa, Erma Musbita Tyastuti, Listy Hasti Mandiri, Alden Ganendra Madhava Priya Hardianto, Banuwati Kartika Sari
pmc-12997002.description: This article presents a dataset describing the bacterial communities of groundwater collected from inside and around public cemeteries in Surakarta, Central Java, Indonesia. Water samples were obtained from wells located inside cemeteries (S1), at 150 m (S2) and 300 m (S3) away from cemetery boundaries across six urban subdistricts.

pmc-13009490.title: In-hospital outcomes and temporal analysis of paralyzed patients with acute myocardial infarction undergoing percutaneous coronary intervention
pmc-13009490.creator: Haohong Qi, Mingzhi Cui, Ting Zhang, Xueping Ma, Bo Shi, Rui Yan, Shizhe Fu, Kairu Wang, Congyan Ye, Ru Yan, Shaobin Jia, Guangzhi Cong
pmc-13009490.description: This study aimed to explore the association between two major etiologies of paralysis and the in-hospital outcomes of patients with acute myocardial infarction (AMI) who had undergone percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI). We retrieved AMI patients undergoing PCI from the National Inpatient Sample (2003–2015) and divided them into without paralysis, spinal cord injury (SCI) paralysis, and stroke paralysis.

pmc-13058531.title: The Impact of Evaluation Strategy on Sepsis Prediction Model Performance Metrics in Intensive Care Data: Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-13058531.creator: Dang-Khoa Do, Patrick Rockenschaub, Sebastian Daniel Boie, Oliver Kumpf, Hans-Dieter Volk, Felix Balzer, Falk von Dincklage, Gregor Lichtner, Javad Sarvestan, Matthias Görges, Huang Shuai-Jing, Robert Heyer
pmc-13058531.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundThe prediction of the onset of sepsis, a life-threatening condition resulting from a dysregulated response to an infection, is one of the most common prediction tasks in intensive care–related machine learning research.

pmc-13186526.title: An increase in the medial proximal tibial angle of 95° or greater after opening wedge high tibial osteotomy does not necessarily lead to excessive knee joint line obliquity of 5° or greater
pmc-13186526.creator: Yuta Hizume, Ken Kumagai, Tomotaka Akamatsu, Shuntaro Nejima, Yusuke Inoue, Hyonmin Choe, Hiroyuki Ike, Naomi Kobayashi, Yutaka Inaba
pmc-13186526.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Introduction: The relationship between medial proximal tibial angle (MPTA) overcorrection and knee joint line obliquity (KJLO) after opening wedge high tibial osteotomy (OWHTO) remains controversial. Though excessive valgus correction (MPTA ≥ 95°) has been associated with abnormal joint line inclination, the extent to which this affects postoperative alignment and whether overcorrection necessarily results in excessive KJLO (≥5°), which has been associated with increased shear stress on the articular cartilage, is unclear.

pmc-13472492.title: Metabolo-politics: Bovine Metabolism and Environmental Biopower
pmc-13472492.creator: Jonathon Turnbull, George Cusworth, Adam Searle, Else Vogel, François Thoreau, Catherine Oliver
pmc-13472492.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). More-than-human metabolic processes increasingly constitute the locus of contemporary biopower, often responding to industrially-altered biogeochemical cycles. We conceptualise ‘metabolo-politics’ to examine the targeting of bodies and populations via interventions in the biochemical surroundings and ecologies that shape them; and simultaneously, the administration and modulation of materials in the environment via interventions in the bodies and populations that ingest, digest, and excrete them.

pmc-13512233.title: Virtual Reality Goggles as a Distraction Technique for Managing Behavioral Conduct During Pulp Pediatric Dental Treatment: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-13512233.creator: Carmen Machuca-Portillo, Maria Biedma-Perea, Cira Suárez-Marchena, Carolina Caleza-Jiménez, Lucy Chandler-Gutiérrez, Lydia López-del Valle, Juan J. Segura-Egea
pmc-13512233.description: Objective: To systematically evaluate the effectiveness of virtual reality (VR) distraction systems in reducing pain perception and dental anxiety during pediatric pulp therapy procedures. Methods: A systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted according to PRISMA 2020 guidelines and registered in PROSPERO (CRD42026139774). PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and Embase were searched for randomized clinical trials evaluating immersive VR distraction during pediatric pulp therapy.

pmc-13535951.title: Outcomes and risk factors of pulpotomy in mature permanent teeth with complicated crown fractures: A 12–60-month prospective clinical study
pmc-13535951.creator: Qiang Li, Yin-Fei Pu, Jia-Jia Zheng, Wei Sun, Xiao Shao
pmc-13535951.description: Background/purposeTraumatic dental injuries (TDIs), especially complicated crown fractures (CCFs), challenge pulp preservation in mature teeth. This study evaluated outcomes and risk factors in mature permanent teeth treated with pulpotomy using iRoot BP Plus.Materials and methodsThis prospective single-arm clinical trial included 47 mature permanent anterior teeth with CCFs and pulp exposures within 24 h post-trauma.

uslaw-usc-t10-s8678.title: 10 U.S.C. § 8678 — Chief of Naval Operations: certification required for disposal of combatant vessels
uslaw-usc-t10-s8678.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s8678.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part IV (General Administration); Chapter 863 (Naval Vessels). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Notwithstanding any other provision of law, no combatant vessel of the Navy may be sold, transferred, or otherwise disposed of unless the Chief of Naval Operations certifies that it is not essential to the defense of the United States.
